The current connection is available and power controls are enabled again. The earlier request result is unchanged.
Wait until the device is available, then disconnect and sign in again to restore power controls.
Try a different search or clear the search field.
Only part of the connection list is available. Refresh to manage connections.
The disconnect request was not sent.
This may also disconnect this app. Unsaved work and active transfers may stop; sign in again to reconnect.
Refresh the drive status, then choose the action again.
Test history could not be loaded. Refresh this drive to try again.
The result of the previous action is unavailable. Refresh the drive status before starting another action.
The drive test action was not sent. Refresh the status to try again.
The NAS did not allow this action. Refresh the drive status or sign in with an account that can manage storage.
The drive test started. Its progress and results appear below.
No matching drives. Change or clear your search.
No matching packages. Try a different search.
The NAS did not accept this action. Refresh the package list before trying again.
The action was not sent. Refresh the list to choose an action.
The latest package status is unavailable. Refresh to see the result before making another change.
No containers. Create one in Container Manager in DSM, then refresh.
No matching containers. Try a different name.
The selection or its current state has changed. Refresh the list and select it again.
This container belongs to a package. Manage it in Package Center.
Actions are unavailable for this container in its current state. Refresh or manage it in DSM.
This starts the selected containers and their services using their saved settings.
Services in the selected containers will stop. Active connections may be interrupted.
Services in the selected containers will be interrupted while they restart.
The selected stopped containers and files stored only inside them will be permanently deleted. Images and data in shared folders will remain.
Running with a newer start time
No longer in the container list
Refresh the status before another action. If it remains unavailable, view the selected containers in DSM.
The activity record could not be saved. Free up space on this device, then reopen this page.
This information could not be loaded. Check your connection and refresh.
No images. Search the registry to download one.
No matching images. Try a different name or tag.
The selected image changed. Refresh and select it again.
This downloads the selected tag to the NAS and uses its storage. It may update an existing tag. Containers will not restart automatically.
The selected tags or untagged images will be removed. You may need to download them again before creating containers. Existing container files are not deleted.
Image usage could not be read. Refresh before deleting images.
Download finished; the image is available
The image could not be downloaded. Check the NAS connection to the registry, then start a new download.
%1$d of %2$d selected images or tags are no longer listed.
Refresh to see the current result. Leaving this page does not stop a download on the NAS.
The connection ended before the download could be tracked. View this image in Container Manager in DSM. This app will not start the same download again.
No networks. Create a network for your containers.
No matching networks. Try a different name.
The selected network changed. Refresh and select it again.
Start with a letter or number. Use only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
Enter a valid IPv4 subnet and gateway. Use CIDR notation for the subnet and address pool.
Enter a valid IPv6 subnet and gateway. Use CIDR notation for the subnet and address pool.
The gateway and address pool must be within the subnet.
Disconnect the containers from this network in DSM before deleting it.
This is a default network and cannot be deleted here.
No longer in the network list
A network with this name is now listed
The result is unavailable. Refresh the network list before another operation on this network.
This creates a network for containers. Address conflicts may prevent containers from connecting.
With IP masquerading disabled, containers may be unable to reach external networks.
The selected unused networks will be removed. You will need to create them again to connect containers to them.
The selected virtual machines will start and use NAS resources.
The selected virtual machines will shut down. Their services will be interrupted.
Power will be cut immediately. Unsaved work may be lost and virtual disks may be damaged.
The selected virtual machines will restart and their services will be interrupted. Restart completion cannot currently be read; further actions will remain unavailable.
The selected virtual machines and their virtual disks will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
No virtual machines. Create one here or in Virtual Machine Manager.
No matching virtual machines. Try another search.
This virtual machine cannot be controlled in its current state. Refresh or open Virtual Machine Manager.
The virtual machine or its state has changed. Refresh and select it again.
The action could not be saved on this device. Free some device storage and reopen the app before trying again.
Could not read the latest information. Check the connection and refresh.
Refresh to read the latest status. To prevent duplicate actions, these controls remain unavailable while the result is unknown.
Virtual Machine Manager is busy. Refresh when the current operation finishes.
No matching items. Try another search.
No networks. Create a network in Virtual Machine Manager.
No images. Import an image to use it with a virtual machine.
The network or its connections have changed. Refresh and select it again.
The image has changed. Refresh and select it again.
A virtual machine is using this image. Eject it in Virtual Machine Manager before deleting it.
This image cannot be deleted here in its current state. Manage it in Virtual Machine Manager.
These networks will be permanently deleted. Connected virtual machines will lose these network connections. This cannot be undone.
These images and all their copies will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
The virtual machine settings have changed or another action is still in progress. Close this form, refresh, and reopen settings.
Shut down the virtual machine before changing processors or memory.
Some settings could not be read. Manage the unavailable fields in Virtual Machine Manager.
System templates use one empty disk and one network interface.
Images could not be loaded. Refresh to choose an image.
Networks could not be loaded. Refresh to choose a network.
The name, resources, or settings have changed. Refresh and choose again.
The virtual machine was created. Continue to save the remaining settings.
The virtual machine is ready. Continue to start it.
The virtual machine was created, but a later step was rejected. Open its details to make further changes.
Could not connect to the virtual machine. Check that it is running, then reconnect.
No import or cleanup activity on this device.
No tasks can be cleared right now. Refresh the task list later.
An image import with this name is still unfinished. Open the import activity or choose a different name.
Shared files could not be loaded. Free up storage and reopen the app.
Wait for the current files to finish copying or sending, then share the next files again.
This connection is unavailable. Finish the current operation and choose the connection again.
The shared files could not be received. Share up to 100 files with different names, and keep the source app available until copying finishes.
Upload tasks created. View their progress in Tasks.
Choose LanStash from another app’s Share menu to upload files.
Close this page and add a connection to upload these files.
Use this folder to upload, or go back to choose another folder.
Files cannot be uploaded to this folder. Choose another folder.
Browse and download files. Manage files in LanStash.
This file is unavailable. Open LanStash, sign in to the original connection, and try again.
No matching connections. Try a different name.
After editing, open Office copies in LanStash to save the changes to your NAS.

Other apps can edit the Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files you select from %1$s. Their changes stay on this device until you save them to the NAS in LanStash. File removal and other changes remain in LanStash.
Close the file in the editor first. If your changes have not appeared here, receive the edited content before saving to the NAS.
New messages are checked while this connection is open in the app. Synced reminders can appear later in the background; battery restrictions may delay them.
Notifications are blocked. Allow Chat notifications in system settings.
Notification settings could not be saved. Try again.
Some reminders could not be updated. Reconnect and try again.
The next 50 reminders are scheduled. Open this connection again to update later reminders.
Open the original conversation to view it.
Open the original connection to view progress.
Return to the app and try again.
